answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to fake but cheap to keep: each agent stakes a small bond and earns reputation through verifiable work, so a sybil swarm pays real cost per fake identity. A genuine agent is like a pearl formed slowly inside its shell, hard to counterfeit at scale, while a haven of trusted peers attests only to agents with a track record. Newcomers start on a narrow ledge with limited privileges and climb only as their history proves them honest.
